note: City of Warsaw's Riverfront Park (Goose Landing) on Mississippi Pool 20. The pads line the park road beside the boat harbor and look west across an open flat to the river, about 130 m away; no levee between. Two boat ramps. Pay at the drop box in the park or at City Hall. The nearest dump station is in town, behind the Water Works on Main Street. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE LEAD: riverfront -> riverview (checked hard; not --AWH). The ~8 angled gravel pads sit on the EAST side of the park road at about 40.3530-40.3539,-91.4453 to -91.4456 (pad row centre ~40.35339,-91.44542); west of the road an open grass flat runs 120-140 m to the Mississippi main channel (bank ~-91.4470 at that latitude). The northern pads face the boat-harbor basin 20-40 m away, but across the park road (a campground's own road blocks on-water). Two or three stubs near the north ramp (~40.3547,-91.4459) sit ~60 m from the river over open grass. No pad within ~50 m of the river over open ground. No levee: the pads and flat are on the river side, at floodplain level. Pads are sold by the night (drop-box self-pay), so view is open and real -> riverview.
